patterns.assumptions: Three‑month window interpreted as 90 days; ten distinct cardholders required; amount range taken from advisory
patterns.name: Multiple credit card repayments to many individuals
patterns.red_flag_quote: repayments to the credit cards of many different individuals, typically ten or more

patterns.assumptions: ‘Several’ taken as at least 2 money orders; combined total must be <£2,500; repeated on at least 2 separate days
patterns.name: Multiple money orders deposited same day below £2,500
patterns.red_flag_quote: several money orders on the same day whose combined value is just below £2,500

untestable.red_flag: Credit card repayments follow shortly after cash or money order deposits into the same account.
untestable.reason: Requires detection of temporal ordering between different transaction types, not expressible in a single pattern.
